what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Venezuela in the United States: people who have asked for protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 405464 Venezuelan asylum seekers in the United States, 34.3% of all Venezuelan asylum seekers.
A smaller group, 29834 people, was counted as Venezuelan refugees there.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Venezuela.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: The figure peaked at 620074 in 2024 and was 405464 at the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025; the figure also changed sharply in many earlier years, including each year from 2013 to 2017.

how.text: These are year-end totals of people whose claims had not yet been decided, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
The figures have no breakdown by gender or age.
The sources don't say how people travelled or where in the United States they live.
